events.title: Border Control Together | Demo Update!
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who tried the Border Control Together demo and shared their feedback! We've released an update with improvements based on your suggestions. 📋 Document Verification We've improved the document verification system. Comparing traveler information with database records is now faster, easier, and more convenient. 🎙️ Voice Chat Added speaking indicators, microphone muting, and the option to disable voice chat audio. These settings are now also covered in the tutorial. 👕 Skin Sele

events.title: Ready to Take Control of the Border Crossing? Demo Is Here!
events.summary: Welcome to the checkpoint, officer! Your shift is about to begin, and new entry regulations, restrictions, and wanted notices are already coming in. Check passports and travel documents, verify information against government records, and inspect vehicles and cargo for contraband. Is everything in order with the next traveler, or are they trying to smuggle something past your checkpoint? Remember: not every decision is as straightforward as it seems. You can do your duty, confiscate illegal goods
